title: Agent Loop RPC Implementation
description:
Implement the Agent Loop RPC Service from docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md, its
test harness (docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md), and the sandbox-host
LaunchProcess addendum (docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add03.md).

Wraps the existing agent loop with a ConnectRPC interface so it can run as a
standalone service. Adds SandboxControl abstraction for unified sandbox lifecycle
management. Introduces the unified flexagent binary with serve subcommands.
